auto.short_description: Monitor on my desk has no signal
auto.description: The second monitor at my desk shows no signal since this morning. I checked the cable at both ends and tried another port on the laptop.

review.description: Please raise a purchase order for five keyboards for the new starters. The quote is attached and the budget holder has approved it.

resolve.short_description: Desk phone has no dial tone
resolve.description: The phone at my new desk has no dial tone since the office move. The number needs to be assigned to the new socket.
resolve.close_notes: The number was still tied to the old socket. Moved it to the new socket in the telephony portal and re-patched the cable in the comms cabinet. Dial tone is back.
